successCriteria: Explore on landing stays in the document and preserves unsent form state.
Current Home/Help/Safety menu links scroll to main rather than reloading the same page, including trailing slash variants.

Header remains usable at 320px and desktop widths, with no overlap or off-screen controls.

Help/legal copy, brand assets, event schemas and production hosting configuration are untouched.
